extends Node

signal health_changed(current: int, max_hp: int)
signal died

@export var max_health: int = 3
@export var invincibility_time: float = 0.5

var current_health: int
var is_invincible: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	current_health = max_health


func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
	if is_invincible or amount <= 0:
		return
	
	current_health = max(0, current_health - amount)
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
	
	if current_health == 0:
		died.emit()
	elif invincibility_time > 0.0:
		_start_invincibility()


func heal(amount: int) -> void:
	if amount <= 0:
		return
	
	current_health = min(max_health, current_health + amount)
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)


func _start_invincibility() -> void:
	is_invincible = true
	await get_tree().create_timer(invincibility_time).timeout
	is_invincible = false

func run_tests(target: Health) -> bool:
	if target == null:
		return false
	
	var original_max: int = target.max_health
	if target.current_health != original_max:
		return false
	
	# Prova danno normale
	target.take_damage(1)
	if target.current_health != original_max - 1:
		return false
	
	# Durante invincibility, un danno ulteriore deve essere ignorato
	if target.invincibility_time > 0.0:
		if not target.is_invincible:
			return false
		target.take_damage(1)
		if target.current_health != original_max - 1:
			return false
	
	# Cura non oltre max_health
	target.is_invincible = false
	target.heal(100)
	if target.current_health > original_max:
		return false
	
	# Danno letale: non sotto lo zero
	target.take_damage(original_max + 10)
	if target.current_health != 0:
		return false

signal health_changed(current: int, max_hp: int)
signal died

@export var max_health: int = 2
@export var invincibility_time: float = 0.0

var current_health: int
var is_invincible: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	current_health = max_health


func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
	if is_invincible or amount <= 0:
		return
	
	current_health = max(0, current_health - amount)
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
	
	if current_health == 0:
		died.emit()
	elif invincibility_time > 0.0:
		_start_invincibility()


func heal(amount: int) -> void:
	if amount <= 0:
		return
	
	current_health = min(max_health, current_health + amount)
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)


func _start_invincibility() -> void:
	is_invincible = true
	await get_tree().create_timer(invincibility_time).timeout
	is_invincible = false
